description.narrative: After the selected partner (CWSI) receives initial induction and training on disability inclusion alongside CAFOD staff in Nigeria from CBM and a local Organisation of Persons with Disability (OPD), this project was co-designed which to embed disability inclusion into CWSI’s work focusing on inclusive governance with an emphasis on women. The anticipated outcome is increased knowledge, technical skills and confidence of CWSI to embed disability inclusion into its project design, implementation and reporting (including data collection and analysis). The emphasis here is learning by doing. 12 months will provide the partner enough time to work through a simplified project cycle practically and capture relevant learning. There will opportunity to receive targeted mentoring from CBM and the OPD and for CAFOD staff to accompany the process and simultaneously learn. The partner will also have opportunity to shadow and have exchange visits with CBM and the OPD.
